parameters: Well, here we are. Care to explain, Abi?
I-I'm so sorry for bringing you here, \n[8]! Azuros has insisted that a battle of the utmost importance is going to take place here!
From the looks of it, he's not kidding...\| we've already attracted a lot of attention from the uh, locals.
\n[8], Azuros is prepared to speak with you...
\c[1]The one called Avatar of Donar listens now.
Whoa... um,\| Yep, I'm all ears!

\c[1]Only two ears, this one has. Curious logic. Irrelevant.\! The enemies of the Avatar of Donar are a threat to my kin.\! Corrupted my brother, Kalytos the Red.\! This one's military will dispatch the enemy here. Then, to the Avatar of Donar, I impart the true power of Azuros the Wise.
\n[8], they've got the eggs of three dragon brood mothers in their possession, and are seeking to control all dragons for the Imperial Army!
Roger. We'll need to split our forces to cover all this ground. Sorry Casamir, no dragon eggs for you today.
